title: Firerate Buff
wikitext_excerpt:
{{BuffInfobox
|name = Firerate Buff
|image = Cooldown Buff.png
|type = Buff
|display = Tower
}}

==Description==
The '''Firerate Buff''' is a buff that decreases a tower's firerate, making them fire faster. It is displayed on the towers using an icon of a lightning bolt.

==Mechanics==
Currently, the '''Firerate Buff''' is calculated as:
::<big>'''Original Firerate ÷ (1 + Firerate Buff)'''</big>
:::where '''Firerate Buff''' is the buff supplied is in decimal form (for example, 10% is 0.1).

While it may look like the firerate of a tower with the '''Firerate Buff''' is rounded up or down to the third decimal, this is only visual. 

Prior to the [[v2.0.0]] update, the firerate of a tower with the [[Firerate Bug]] was calculated as:
::<big>'''(Bugged Firerate - [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]) ÷ (1 + Firerate Buff) + [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]'''</big>
:::where ''Bugged Firerate'' was the firerate with the [[Firerate Bug]].

Prior to the [[V1.1.0|Entity System Update]], the '''Firerate Buff''' was calculated as:

::Without the [[Firerate Bug]]:
:::<big>'''Original Firerate × (1-Firerate Buff)'''</big>
::With the [[Firerate Bug]]:
:::<big>'''((Bugged Firerate - [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]) × (1 - Firerate Buff)) + [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]'''</big>

The following towers are either partially or fully not affected by the '''Firerate Buff''':
*All [[units]].
*Ability cooldowns.
*Units spawnrates.
*The [[Commander]]; the [[Commander]] cannot boost the firerate of other [[Commander]]s.
*Firerate of secondary attacks, like the [[Pursuit]]'s missiles.
**Their main firerate can still be decreased.
*Tick of the [[Pyromancer]], [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Cryomancer]], [[Slasher]] and [[Swarmer]].
**The tick of the [[Accelerator]] can still be decreased.
*The rev-up of the [[Minigunner]].
*Charge-up and cooldown of the [[Accelerator]].
**The cooldown of burst towers like the [[Soldier]] or [[Toxic Gunner]] also cannot be decreased.
*The [[Executioner]]; the firerate will not be decreased if the axe takes too long to return.
*The [[Archer]]; the '''Firerate Buff''' can decrease the time it takes for it to reload its bow, but it cannot decrease the time it takes it to aim at enemies.

The pump time for the [[Enforcer]] is also affected by this buff.

==Applied By==
The following towers have the '''Firerate Buff''':

*[[Gladiator]] (''Warrior's Call'' ability)

The following towers or consumables can apply the '''Firerate Buff''' to other towers:

*[[Commander]] (Passive and ''Call to Arms'' ability)
*[[Medic]] (Passive to assigned towers)
*[[War Machine]] (Passive)
*[[Cooldown Flag]] (Passive)
*[[Sugar Rush (Consumable)|Sugar Rush]] (Passive)
*[[Easter Egg]] (Passive for 20 seconds)
The following event enemies can apply the '''Firerate Buff''' to towers:

* [[Null Guardian]] (''Null Aura'' ability, [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]])
* [[Null Guardian Clone]] (''Null Aura'' ability, [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]])
The following event features can apply the '''Firerate Buff''' to towers:

* [[The Chariot]] (Passive, [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]])

title: Firework Buff
wikitext_excerpt:
{{BuffInfobox
|name = Firework buff
|image = FireworkBuffIcon.png
|type = Buff
|display = Upgrade Menu
}}

==Description==
The '''Firework Buff''' is a buff that gives the tower a chance to fire a firework at an enemy. It appears in the tower's upgrade menu, specifically the top left part of the preview.

==Mechanics==
This buff is activated upon enemy receiving damage from a tower with their main attack, in most cases this will give it a chance to activate it, though some towers can never activate it. There is a chance that the buff will activate itself, which is determined using the ''Firework Shot Chance Cap'' value from the '''Firework Buff''' giver and the ''Firerate'' statistic of the tower the firework is fired from. A tower has a chance to create a firework for each enemy hit, meaning that towers which can hit multiple enemies, like the [[Hallow Punk]] or [[Electroshocker]], are capable of generating multiple fireworks at once. 

The chance is calculated as:

<math>\frac{\text{Firework Shot Chance Cap}}{1+2.718^{\left(-0.5\times\left(Firerate-6\right)\right)}}</math>

where ''Firework Shot Chance Cap'' is taken from the [[Firework Technician]], and ''Firerate'' is taken from the tower that fires out the firework. Firerate in this case is the statistic displayed with the hour glass to the right of the tower. In most cases, this is the firerate statistic (time between each shot), though in some cases it may be the burst cooldown (time between bursts), like the [[Elementalist]], the spawnrate, like the [[Military Base]] or just unrelated to any statistic it has, such as the [[Trapper]].

Multiple towers are not affected by this buff, while some can create multiple fireworks. A full list of towers affected fully, partially or that are unaffected can be found below. Only accounts for the main attack and units.
{{FireworkBuff}}

==Applied By==
The following towers can apply the '''Firework Buff''' to other towers:
*[[Firework Technician]] (Passive)

==Update History==
*'''31 December 2024''' - [[v1.47.0|v1.47.5c]]
**'''Firework Buff''' added.
*'''15 January 2025''' - [[v1.49.0]]
**'''Firework Buff''' is now triggered by burst towers more consistently.

Build up chill to slow and freeze enemies in their tracks!|Store Description}} |-|Version 3 = {{QuoteBox|Chill enemies to a slow freeze!|Store Description}} |-|Version 2 = {{QuoteBox|Shoot an ice beam, freezing targets for a few seconds.|Store Description}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|Freeze zombies temporarily with a freeze ray!|Former Store Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Freezer''' is a ground [[Towers|tower]] that fires an ice beam and applies chill and slow down enemies, freezing at later levels. It can be bought in the store for {{Coins|650}}. The '''Freezer''' targets a single enemy and fires a ''Frost Ray'', chilling the enemy and slowing it down. The chillness slowness effect stacks with each hit multiple times. This chillness effect also deals damage over time, chipping away the health of enemies affected by it. Starting from Level 2, it can freeze enemies. When the chillness slowness effect is higher than the max slowdown, the enemy will be frozen, which generally when targeting a single enemy takes four or five shots. Larger enemies will be frozen for a shorter amount of time than average sized enemies. Enemies with [[Freeze Immunity]] also cannot be frozen, slowed down or have their defense dropped by the '''Freezer'''. At Level 3+, the '''Freezer''' fires in bursts, with a short delay between them. Additionally, at Level 3+, it drops defense by 10% every tick. It can only decrease an enemy's defense by 33%. For example, if an enemy has 50% defense, it will be decreased by 16%. On top of this, it will also start dealing damage over time with its chill at Level 3. Additionally at Level 4, the '''Freezer''' gains the ability to throw a '''Frost Grenade''', freezing enemies within an explosion radius. The '''Freezer''' does well as an all-rounder support tower. Due to its generally low price and decent DPS, the '''Freezer''' can be a solid choice for early-game defense to mid game with very good cost efficiency. Towards late game, the '''Freezer''' is useful for stalling, defense melting and deal additional DPS through its damage over time, though its DPS is insufficient to deal with late-game waves alone. The '''Freezer''' has [[Lead (Attribute)|lead]] detection from Level 0 and [[Hidden (Attribute)|hidden]] detection from level 2. title: Stun Immunity
wikitext_excerpt:
{{AttributeInfobox |image1 = Energy.png |type = Immunity |variants = Regular
{{Attr|Boss}} |immunities = Regular: *{{Stun}}Stun *{{Knockback}}Knockback {{Boss}}[[Boss]]: *{{Stun}}Stun *{{Stun|Partial Stun Slowdown}}Partial Stun Slowdown *{{Knockback}}Knockback Towers: *{{Stun|Enemy Stuns}}Enemy Stuns *Enemy Targeting |sandbox = No |tag = {{AttrTag|second|Energy.png|No Stun}} }} ==Description== '''Stun Immunity''' (referred to as "''No Stun''" on its tag) is an immunity that prevents the enemy from being stunned and knocked back. For towers, it fully or partially prevents them from being stunned and targeted by enemies. ==Mechanics== '''Stun Immunity''' makes it so that any enemy with it cannot be stunned/shocked by towers. They will instead be slowed down by 40% for the stun duration. The '''Stun Immunity''' also grants immunity to being knocked back. The following towers/consumables become unable to apply these effects or have them be weakened to '''Stun Immune''' enemies: *[[Electroshocker]] (Shock) *[[Trapper]] (Stun) *[[Warden]] (Shock) *[[DJ Booth]] (Knockback) *[[Tesla]] (Shock) *[[Mercenary Base]] (Knockback) *[[Brawler]] (Knockback) *[[Commando]] (Stun) *[[Archer]] (Shock) *[[Hallow Punk]] (Knockback) *[[Elementalist]] (Knockback) *[[Warlock]] (Knockback) *[[Flash Bang]] (Stun) *[[Ducky Squad]] ([[Shock Ducky]]) All [[Boss]] enemies have this immunity, as part of being a [[Boss]] enemy. The only difference between the two is that the slowdown effect is weaker on [[Boss]] enemies, as it is 20%. If a [[Boss]] enemy also has the [[Stun Immunity]], it will only be slowed down by 10% instead. ===Towers=== '''Stun Immunity''' makes towers unaffected by stuns from enemies and, in multiple cases, also prevents them from being targeted from such attacks. The immunity to being attacked also applies to some enemy attacks which normally would actually affect them, that being freeze and debuffs. For example, the [[Unstable Ice]] from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]] will not jump at any tower with '''Stun Immunity''' visible in their upgrade menu, even though it can actually freeze them. Similarly, enemies like the [[Clown]] will avoid applying debuffs to towers with '''Stun Immunity''', even if they can be debuffed. Some towers, such as cliff units, also have '''Stun Immunity''', though it is not displayed in their upgrade menu and it is far less effective at preventing them from being targeted by enemy abilities. ==Enemy List== The following enemies have '''Stun Immunity''': {{Scroll|text= *[[Hazmat]] *[[Fallen Hazmat]] *[[Elite Hazmat]] *[[Hazardous]] *[[Fallen]] ([[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] only) *[[Molten Golem]] *[[Giant Boss]] *[[Amalgamation]] ([[Polluted Wasteland II]]) *[[Shotgunner (Pizza Party)|Shotgunner]] *[[Giant Skeleton]] *[[Cobalt Guard]] *[[Failed Experiment]] *[[Mega Slow]] *[[Fallen Giant]] *[[Fallen Reaper]] *[[Fallen Necromancer]] *[[Fallen Soul (Legacy)|Fallen Soul]] (Legacy version) *[[Glitch]] *[[Fallen Titan]] *[[Fallen Shield]] *[[Fallen Summoner]] ([[Fallen Mode|Fallen]]) *[[Frost Invader]] ([[Frost Mode|Frost]]) *[[Bulwark]] *[[Tanker]] *[[Templar]] (Legacy version) *[[Warden (Legacy Enemy)|Warden]] *[[Slow King (Legacy)|Slow King]] (Legacy version) *[[Speedy King (Legacy)|Speedy King]] (Legacy version) *[[Summoner Boss]] *[[Necromancer King]] *[[Conjurer]] *[[Reaper]] *[[Demon]] *[[Error]] *[[Circuit (Hardcore)|Circuit]] ([[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]]) *[[Circuit (Polluted Wasteland II)|Circuit]] ([[Polluted Wasteland II]]) *[[Molten Titan (Legacy)|Molten Titan]] (Legacy version) *[[Fallen Hero]] *[[Fallen Hero (Legacy)|Fallen Hero]] (Legacy version) *[[Super Toxic]] *[[Mimic Umbra]] *[[Abomination]] *[[Commander (Pizza Party)|Commander]] *[[Fallen Honor Guard]] *[[Packed Ice]] *[[Snow Minion]] *[[Blizzard Wizard]] *[[Frost Hunter]] *[[Frostbane]] *[[Frost Ravager]] *[[Shivergeist]] *[[Frost Hero]] *[[Deep Freeze]] *[[Mega Frost Mystery]] *[[Frost Necromancer]] *[[Frost Champion]] *[[Nuclear Guardia
